Class VulkanModuleVulkan

java.lang.Object
io.codetoil.curved_spacetime.MainCallback
io.codetoil.curved_spacetime.vulkan.VulkanModuleVulkan
public class VulkanModuleVulkan extends MainCallback
Owns the Vulkan objects that outlive any one window: the instance, the physical device, and the logical device.

Registered as a MainCallback so that its lifetime is tied to the engine rather than to a scene. Everything scene- or surface-specific — swap chains, render passes, framebuffers — is built on top of these by the render modules, which reach them through the getters here.

Creation order matters and is not negotiable: the instance must exist before a physical device can be selected, and a physical device before a logical one can be created. clean() unwinds in the reverse order, after waiting for the device to go idle.
